url.title: URL
url.description: The page that was fetched (before any redirects).

ok.title: OK
ok.description: Whether the request completed and returned a response.

httpStatus.title: HTTP status
httpStatus.description: Final status code after following any redirects. Omitted entirely when the request never completed.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Link-hops from the start URL that this page was discovered at. 0 for a start URL itself.

title.title: Page title
title.description: Text content of the page's <title> tag. Empty if missing or the response was not HTML.

metaDescriptionLength.title: Meta description length
metaDescriptionLength.description: Character length of the <meta name="description"> content attribute. 0 if missing.

brokenLinks.title: Broken links
brokenLinks.description: Links found on this page (internal or external) that returned an error or an HTTP status >= 400, up to 20 checked per page.

redirectChain.title: Redirect chain
redirectChain.description: Every URL hopped through after the initial request, in order, ending with the final URL. Empty if the request was not redirected.

hasStructuredData.title: Has structured data
hasStructuredData.description: True if the page has a non-empty application/ld+json script or a microdata (itemscope) element.

imagesMissingAlt.title: Images missing alt text
imagesMissingAlt.description: Count of tags with no alt attribute or an empty one.

mixedContentFound.title: Mixed content found
mixedContentFound.description: True if an HTTPS page loads any resource (script, image, stylesheet, etc.) over plain HTTP.

latencyMs.title: Latency (ms)
latencyMs.description: How long the page request took, in milliseconds.

charged.title: Charged
charged.description: Whether this row was billed under pay-per-event. Always false while the Actor has no price set.

error.title: Error
error.description: Set when the request failed outright (never got a response). Empty otherwise.
